Applying them to tangent-generator lifts yields an automorphism of the full truncated commutative polynomial algebra, so all retractions simultaneously linearize. Exact symmetric monomial weight counts give the centralizer order, hence the Gaussian/general-linear orbit count, and the product retraction ranks are binomial(r+d,d). Direct exhaustive GF(2) substitution checks for n=t=2,d=3 independently yield 770 retractions and 9988 commuting pairs.
